name.description: The main type identifier for this sensor association specification.

spec.description: Control the inputs to be used for sensor association.

sensorAssociationJobId.description: Use this field to specify the id to be used when creating the {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationJob}

sensorAssociationJobOptions.description: Control the parallelization of sensor association with {@link MapReduceOptions}.

createSensorRelations.description:
Specify whether or not to create {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}s using the results of the completed
sensor association job that is run as a part of the same workflow.

sensorSelectionSpec.description:
If {@link #createSensorRelations} is set to true, use this field to specify how to retrieve the top correlated
{@link Sensor}s for each {@link ReliabilityAsset}, so that corresponding {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}s
can be created.

removeRelations.description:
If {@link #createSensorRelations} is set to true, use this field to specify whether or not to remove existing
{@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}s that were created from earlier {ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationJob}s,
before creating the sensor relations corresponding to the {@link ReliabilityAsset#latestSensorAssociationRun}
for each asset.

sensorSelectionJobOptions.description:
If {@link #createSensorRelations} is set to true,  use this field to control the parallelization of the
{@link ReliabilityAssetCreateSensorRelationsJob} that is used to create {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}s
for each {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

title:
Defines the sensor association specification used in reliability project agnostic workflows.
This type provides configuration and execution options for associating sensors
with reliability assets, leveraging correlation-based analysis and job parallelization.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.SensorAssociation
